name: Little Tree | 200mg Hash Rosin Gummies | Orange
description:
10 Gummies | 20MG Each | Solventless Hash Rosin

Bold. Consistent. Adventure-Ready.

Our Orange Hash Rosin Gummies are crafted to brighten your day with citrus zest and a reliably smooth high. Infused with solventless hash rosin, each gummy delivers 20MG of clean, full-spectrum potency that uplifts the spirit and awakens the senses.

With a burst of bright, tangy orange flavor and a soft, consistent texture, this gummy offers a fresh way to embrace the day.

Whether you're heading into nature or diving into a new project—this gummy brings clarity to the moment.
